problem_text:
A logistics company must dispatch a single inspection team to evaluate nine distinct regional facilities.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Beta: 102.6 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 183.2 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 48.8 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 143.3 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 11.7 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 183.2 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 100.5 minutes
* Alpha to Iota: 163.6 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 83.2 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 91.2 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 81.0 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 93.3 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 86.1 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 98.2 minutes
* Beta to Iota: 62.0 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 159.5 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 80.4 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 172.8 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 13.0 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 139.9 minutes
* Gamma to Iota: 22.5 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 103.4 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 38.8 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 156.3 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 52.0 minutes
* Delta to Iota: 143.6 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 131.6 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 70.8 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 66.1 minutes
* Epsilon to Iota: 78.1 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 172.4 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 89.8 minutes
* Zeta to Iota: 153.6 minutes
* Theta to Eta: 132.9 minutes
* Theta to Iota: 30.4 minutes
* Eta to Iota: 130.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, where the team must visit every facility precisely once before concluding the tour at the initial facility.
